title: Stop Selling Your Hours
hook_text: YOUR TIME HAS A HARD CEILING

beats.say: You're trading your limited hours for depreciating dollars. Here's the math on why you will hit a wall.
beats.visual: A lone mechanical clock ticking in a dim, minimalist room, dramatic side lighting, 35mm film still.

beats.say: Your paycheck stops the second you stop working. But what if you packaged your knowledge into a product?
beats.visual: A vintage typewriter keys pressing down on blank heavy paper, close-up macro shot, soft warm light.

beats.say: That's how you separate your income from your time. You sell the system, not your labor.
beats.visual: An organized stack of blueprints resting on a dark oak desk, moody lighting, shallow depth of field.

beats.say: To build that base, use investor Alex Hormozi's Rule of 100. Do one primary action every single day.
beats.visual: A hand crossing off boxes on a clean leather notebook with a black fountain pen, top-down view.

beats.say: Do 100 reach-outs, or publish 100 minutes of content. Volume builds the asset before the cash flows.
beats.visual: Rows of identical minimalist ceramic mugs on a dark shelf, cinematic framing, moody ambient light.

beats.say: Then you apply the value equation. Maximize the dream outcome and drop the effort required from the client.
beats.visual: A sleek brass scale balancing on a slate table, dramatic sidelight, high contrast.

beats.say: That's how a single guide or template sells a thousand times while you sleep.
beats.visual: A glowing digital screen reflecting on a dark window pane at night, cinematic street view outside.

beats.say: But here's the honest catch. About 1 in 5 businesses close in their first year.
beats.visual: A heavy wooden door closing slowly in an empty hallway, dark shadows, dramatic focal point.

beats.say: Building a system takes relentless execution and years of unpaid groundwork before it prints.
beats.visual: A welder's bright spark illuminating a dark industrial workshop, high contrast, cinematic atmosphere.

beats.say: Follow for the money rules school never taught. Like why...
beats.visual: A person walking down a long concrete tunnel toward a distant light, wide angle, cinematic framing.

caption: Package what works so your income isn't capped by your time. #moneypsychology #wealthbuilding #personalfinance #businesstips #financialfreedom
description: Stop trading hours for dollars. Learn how to package your knowledge into a repeatable product and build true leverage.
first_comment: What knowledge do you have that could become a repeatable product?

facts.claim: About 1 in 5 US businesses close in their first year.
facts.basis: US Bureau of Labor Statistics, Business Employment Dynamics

facts.claim: Rule of 100 means 100 primary actions a day for 100 days.
